# emcp-go

> Enterprise MCP Extensions for Go -- unified client+server library built on the official MCP Go SDK. gRPC bidirectional stream transport, PID file discovery, bearer auth.

Module: github.com/grpmsoft/emcp-go
Go: 1.27+
License: Apache-2.0
Organization: grpmsoft (github.com/grpmsoft)

## Overview

Thin extension layer on top of the official MCP Go SDK (github.com/modelcontextprotocol/go-sdk v1.8.0). Adds a unified client+server abstraction and gRPC transport. Does not reimplement MCP -- delegates all protocol work to the official SDK.

Two capabilities: (1) Unified Client connecting via HTTP/gRPC/stdio with one NewClient call, with PID file auto-discovery for daemon-managed servers. (2) gRPC bidirectional stream transport for full-duplex MCP over gRPC.

## API

### Client

- NewClient(Config) (*Client, error) -- eagerly connects
- Client.ListTools(ctx) ([]*ToolInfo, error)
- Client.CallTool(ctx, name, args) (*ToolResult, error)
- Client.Ping(ctx) error
- Client.Close() error

### Config

- Endpoint (string) -- HTTP URL or gRPC host:port
- PIDFile (string) -- daemon PID file for auto-discovery (reads port + token)
- Transport (Transport) -- TransportHTTP, TransportGRPC, TransportStdio, TransportAuto
- Command / Args -- for stdio transport
- BearerToken (string) -- HTTP auth; auto-read from PID file
- Timeout (time.Duration) -- per-call timeout, 0 = none

### Server

- NewServer(ServerConfig) *Server
- Server.AddTool(name, description, inputSchema, handler)
- Server.HTTPHandler() http.Handler -- Streamable HTTP
- Server.GRPCHandler() *grpc.GRPCHandler -- register with grpc.Server
- Server.Close() error

### ServerConfig

- Name (string) -- server name in MCP initialize
- Version (string) -- server version
- Instructions (string) -- optional client instructions

### ToolHandler

func(ctx context.Context, name string, args map[string]any) (*ToolResult, error)

### Result Types

- ToolInfo -- Name, Title, Description, InputSchema
- ToolResult -- Content []ContentItem, IsError bool
- ContentItem -- Type (text/image/audio), Text, MIMEType, Data
- TextResult(text) -- convenience: single text content item
- ErrorResult(msg) -- convenience: text with IsError=true

### PID File Discovery

- DaemonInfo -- PID, Port, Name, Token
- ReadPIDFile(path) (*DaemonInfo, error)
- ErrPIDFileNotFound, ErrPIDFileEmpty -- sentinel errors

### gRPC Transport (grpc/ package)

- GRPCTransport -- implements mcp.Transport; client-side
- GRPCHandler -- bridges gRPC stream to mcp.Server; server-side
- Proto: MCPTransport.Stream(MCPMessage) -- JSON-RPC as opaque bytes in protobuf frames

### Typed gRPC (grpc/typed/ package)

- TypedClient -- MCP over typed gRPC RPCs (ListTools, CallTool)
- TypedServer -- standalone tool registry (2 of 8 RPCs implemented, 6 Unimplemented)
- Proto: Google canonical proto (GoogleCloudPlatform/mcp-grpc-transport-proto@1d2216c), experimental

## File Structure

```
emcp.go         -- Client (NewClient, ListTools, CallTool, Ping, Close)
server.go       -- Server (NewServer, AddTool, HTTPHandler, GRPCHandler)
config.go       -- Config, Transport enum
types.go        -- ToolInfo, ToolResult, ContentItem
discovery.go    -- DaemonInfo, ReadPIDFile, sentinel errors
grpc/
  transport.go  -- GRPCTransport (mcp.Transport)
  handler.go    -- GRPCHandler (gRPC stream -> mcp.Server)
  connection.go -- grpcConnection (concurrent-safe mcp.Connection)
  errors.go     -- ErrStreamClosed
  proto/emcpv1/ -- MCPTransport protobuf service
grpc/typed/
  client.go     -- TypedClient
  server.go     -- TypedServer
  convert.go    -- protobuf <-> SDK conversions
  proto/mcppb/  -- Google canonical proto
internal/
  mcpclient/    -- Client impl (session mgmt, reconnect, bearer auth)
  mcpserver/    -- Server impl (tool dispatch, arg extraction)
```
